title: Arquiteto(a) de Dados Sr
description:
Job description

A área de Arquitetura de Dados é responsável por definir visão, princípios, padrões e desenho de soluções para que a organização tenha dados confiáveis, seguros, bem catalogados e interoperáveis, habilitando analytics e IA com escalabilidade e eficiência. Atua como agente de transformação, estruturando uma plataforma resiliente, promovendo democratização com controle, e consolidando uma cultura orientada a dados e governança. Missão da Vaga Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de dados corporativa (plataforma, integração, modelagem, metadados e governança), garantindo coerência técnica, qualidade, segurança, conformidade e eficiência de custos (FinOps). Conduzir decisões arquiteturais com stakeholders, estabelecer padrões e guiar times na implementação de soluções que sustentem dados e IA em escala.

Main responsibilities

  • Definir arquiteturas-alvo para Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, streaming e integrações (batch/real-time), alinhadas à estratégia do negócio;
  • Estabelecer padrões, blueprints e guidelines (nomenclatura, particionamento, versionamento, camadas, contratos de dados, SLAs/SLOs);
  • Liderar revisões arquiteturais (architecture reviews), garantindo aderência a padrões, segurança e governança;
  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos;
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados;
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração;
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos;
  • Desenhar e operacionalizar governança: domínios, ownership (data owner/steward), política de acesso, classificação de dados, LGPD, retenção e trilhas de auditoria;
  • Implantar e evoluir metadados e catálogo, linhagem (lineage), glossário de negócio e dicionário técnico;
  • Definir e monitorar controles de qualidade (regras, thresholds, reconciliações), com gestão de incidentes e indicadores;
  • Orientar escolhas de serviços e desenho em nuvem, garantindo segurança by design (IAM, KMS/Secret Manager, criptografia, segregação);
  • Definir observabilidade de dados: monitoramento, alertas, tracing, dashboards, governança de pipelines e disponibilidade.

Requirements and skills

Formação e experiência

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz(tableau, power bi e/ou looker);
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem.

Conhecimentos técnicos

  • Cloud & Data Platform: experiência com GCP (BigQuery, Composer/Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run/Functions, KMS/Secret Manager, Datastream, GitHub) e/ou Azure (ADF, Synapse, ADLS);
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager, DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Arquitetura de integração: batch, streaming, CDC, APIs; desenho de camadas e padrões de ingestão/transformação/consumo;
  • Modelagem de dados: dimensional, relacional, data vault (se aplicável), modelagem para analytics/BI e camada semântica;
  • Governança & Segurança: classificação e controle de acesso, LGPD, criptografia, políticas e auditoria, catálogo/linhagem/metadados;
  • DataOps/DevOps: CI/CD, testes de dados, versionamento, automação e boas práticas de operação;
  • Performance & custo: otimização de consultas, particionamento, clustering, tuning e práticas de FinOps;
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados);
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados;
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos;
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações em dados/cloud (GCP Professional Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer, ou afins);
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de catálogo/linhagem/governança (ex.: DataPlex/Dataproc Metastore, Purview, Collibra, Alation, etc.);
  • Experiência com dados para IA/ML (feature store, versionamento de dados, governança para modelos e rastreabilidade).

Competências Técnicas

  • Capacidade de projetar arquiteturas escaláveis, seguras e governáveis;
  • Pensamento sistêmico: visão de ponta a ponta (origem → integração → consumo → auditoria);
  • Tomada de decisão arquitetural baseada em trade-offs (prazo, risco, custo, valor);
  • Forte habilidade de solucionar problemas complexos de dados com eficiência e criatividade.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Influência para conduzir alinhamentos entre áreas e sustentar padrões;
  • Senso de dono(a), pragmatismo e foco em resultados com governança aplicada (não “governança de papel”);
  • Pensamento analítico e orientado a resultados;
  • Excelente comunicação para traduzir necessidades técnicas e de negócio;
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência para atender demandas críticas;
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e liderança colaborativa;
  • Compromisso com a aprendizagem contínua e atualização tecnológica.

Additional information

E tem mais, confira o nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes
  • PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual
  • Convênio Farmácia . Descontos de até 85%

  • Seguro de Vida – seguro para todos os colaboradores a partir da data de admissão, sem participação.
  • Extensão das Licenças - Maternidade (total de 180 dias) e Paternidade (total de 20 dias).

  • Clube Smiles Corporativo - Descontos de até 50% nos planos oferecidos para você planejar suas viagens. Disponível também para cônjuge e filhos 18+.
  • Adicional por tempo de serviço – Oferecemos ao colaborador um adicional de salário (de acordo ao tempo de casa) a ser pago por ocasião de férias.

E para o desenvolvimento de nossas equipes...

title: Manager, Marketing Operations Strategist
description:
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Manager, Marketing Operations to coordinate Toptal’s marketing initiatives and drive them to successful outcomes. This position plays a pivotal role in the organization - it blends strategic reputation and brand perception stewardship with hands‑on marketing operations enablement. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, marketing operations rigor, and the ability to manage sensitive customer feedback at scale.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with senior leaders across Marketing Strategy, Growth Product, Revenue, Creative, and Events to ensure marketing operations are directly aligned with business needs. Your work will involve coordinating projects across product, brand, content, events, and creative operations, balancing analytical rigor with strong project management execution.

You will also own the end‑to‑end management of third‑party review platforms such as Trustpilot, G2, Clutch, and similar organizations. You will develop and execute strategies, processes, and communications that elevate Toptal’s external reputation while transforming customer feedback into actionable insights for Marketing and business leadership.

This role combines data‑driven marketing operations and reputation management, bringing together reporting and analysis with operational enablement. Through this work, you will help ensure Marketing operates at scale while continuously improving how the Toptal brand is represented and perceived externally.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Develop and implement customer experience communications strategies relative to third‑party organizations and among key internal and external stakeholders.
  • Project manage initiatives and projects across marketing functions, ensuring alignment with business needs, utilizing our in-house operations management tools.
  • Manage workflows, improve processes, and facilitate review cycles to deliver projects on time and with quality, ensuring that project management tools like Asana are reporting accurate and helpful information.
  • Perform regular and ad‑hoc analyses using SQL, Google Sheets, or other reporting tools to provide actionable insights and verify activities. Track, report, and measure the success of activities.
  • Provide thought leadership, strategic insight, and clear communication (written and verbal) to your team and the organization on the company’s marketing strategy.
  • Develop and implement cross‑functional communications plans and processes for customer feedback and assessments.
  • Write and present clear updates and progress reports that translate data into narratives for leadership and functional peers.
  • Build relationships and coordinate with third‑party organizations to provide information, analyze and interpret data and respond to inquiries.
  • Work with internal business leaders to respond to clients, social media, and other inquiries related to third‑party assessments.
  • Partner with executives and senior leaders to achieve successful outcomes through major Marketing initiatives that result in new offerings, enhanced infrastructure, and processes. Your ability to learn the business, partner with executives, develop recommendations, and act swiftly to drive to completion will be key to your success.
  • Be in constant communication with team members via Slack and Zoom.
  • Identify many optimizations and opportunities that you see relating to furthering the growth tactics, organizational dynamics, and talent capabilities of the Marketing team.
  • Accomplish work objectives through leading and supervising other Toptal team members within Marketing Operations.
  • Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team’s structure and jobs, and organize, assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work.
  • Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans, if needed.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 6-8 years of experience in marketing operations, project management, campaign execution, or comparable experience in consulting, strategy or a similar type of role where you leveraged extensive amounts of data to draw insights about potential customers and marketing strategies, and thus make decisions on the best path forward based on those insights.
  • Experience with TrustPilot, G2, Clutch and other review sites.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to document processes. Experience with project management tools, such as Asana, is preferred.
  • You have supported creative workflows, including intake, briefs, and quality assurance.
  • Experience managing social media channels is a plus.
  • A working knowledge of Google Sheets/Excel is required, while experience with SQL or Power BI is preferred.
  • You are process‑oriented, ensuring activities are scalable, documented, and repeatable. You thrive on process improvement and can support the adoption of new tools and operations; familiarity with process modeling or AI‑driven automation is a plus.
  • You are proactive and adaptable, thriving in fast‑paced, changing environments while keeping projects on track.
  • You collaborate effectively across teams, building trust and alignment, and you adopt a growth mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with impeccable grammar and a command of the English language. These skills are effectively utilized through collaboration tools like Slack and presentation tools like Slides.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • We’re looking for someone who will meticulously analyze and provide insightful feedback on all of the creative, copy, images, growth tactics, and other types of work output related to Marketing initiatives, not simply a high‑level strategist. We expect such reviews to be meaningful and to provide insightful feedback to all team members working on a given initiative.
  • You must be a world‑class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Do you want to impact our clients with your vision and experience? Do you believe in the power of doing more for clients?

Please submit all application materials, including your résumé, in English.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Develop and Implement Industry Growth Strategy: Define and implement a strategic plan to expand market share within the vertical, including identifying market opportunities and setting clear objectives.
  • Build and Maintain Client Relationships: Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with key client partners, understanding their business challenges and proactively identifying ways the firm can add new value.
  • Lead Business Development Efforts: Drive regional pipeline generation and conversion by identifying and prioritizing new opportunities and supporting regional sales teams on large enterprise deals.
  • Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility.
  • Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.
  • Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant.
  • Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical.
  • Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges.

How this opportunity is different

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Ten plus years of experience in compensation.
  • Proven track record in the Natural Resources and Energy segment leading and driving growth in a complex global environment. Exceptional influential leadership.
  • Fluency in the English language.
  • Deep understanding of Human Capital universe and needs of clients across all segments, with strengths across Rewards and Analytics.
  • Hands‑on experience of shaping and executing against a client‑focused vision.
  • Proven track record of building go‑to‑market strategies and driving sustained results over both a short and long‑term horizon.
  • Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens.
  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work… and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the \'Control Room\' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \'Visualizations\' and that the \'Data Pipelines\' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • 1 0+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.

title: Legacy Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long-lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
  1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
  2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender-based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
  3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post-tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your profile

  • Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations: Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Legacy Development
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organizing, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post-event reporting.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Analista Operações Logísticas, AMXL
description:
Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejan itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logística do Brasil está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time que gerencia as operações de Extra Large (AMXL). Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em escala 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back. Essa pessoa atuará na gestão e execução tática das rotinas nas estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos. Essa pessoa também será a guardiã dos processos e padrões da Amazon específicos para a operação de produtos pesados e grandes (Heavy and Bulky). Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria/visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco para atuar como guardião dos SOPs padrões do node.

Key job responsibilities

  • Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;
  • Orientar e liderar plano de ação com parceiros em busca da excelência operacional;
  • Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;
  • Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;
  • Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
  • Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais.

A day in the life

Seu dia é dedicado a monitorar a Torre de Controle e executar rotinas diárias no node para entregas de produtos Pesados/Grandes (Heavy/Bulky). Você é o guardião dos SOPs da AMXL, realizando consultas no sistema, gerenciando o check-in dos motoristas e abrindo tickets de suporte. Você coordena com a equipe para resolver desafios operacionais para encantar o cliente Amazon. Seu principal contato é o parceiro AMXL, cuja performance você melhora diretamente através de planos de ações consolidados.

Requirements

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.
  • MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens em 25% do tempo.
  • Inglês básico.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • SQL e outras linguagens de programação.
  • Experiência em Logística, e/ou Transportes de itens volumosos e pesados.
